//: autoNod configuration. Edit this to fit your project. Deny always wins over allow.
//backendDomains: Add YOUR backend hosts here. Any edit that writes one of these, or any bash referencing them, is denied. Empty by default so nothing false-positives until you opt in.
//extraDenyPaths: Glob-ish substrings. Any tool touching a path containing one of these is denied.
//autoApproveSafeBash: If true, a curated allowlist of harmless frontend bash (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun run dev|build|lint|test|format|typecheck, tsc, eslint, prettier, git status/diff/log) is auto-approved. Dangerous bash is still denied; unknown bash still prompts.
//denyAllNetworkTools: If true, Claude's own WebFetch/WebSearch are always denied (prevents Claude exfiltrating anything over the network).
